description: The field-level rules of this tenant, plus — and this matters — exactly WHERE they take effect today and where they do not yet. A rule someone believes applies everywhere while it only holds at one surface is worse than no rule: it creates trust that is not backed. Optional: role (only that role's rules), plus 'for_resource' to see the effective hidden field list a given role would get on a given resource.

for_resource.description: Show the effective hidden fields the role gets on this resource

role.description: Only the rules of this role

name: list_field_permissions
